questions.question: What extra condition turns a group into an Abelian group?
options: The set has exactly two elements
Every element is equal to the identity
The operation is written using addition notation
questions.explanation: An Abelian group is a group whose operation additionally satisfies $a*b=b*a$ for every pair, namely commutativity.
